name: @rhyek/oxc-config
description: Shared oxlint and oxfmt configuration: ESLint's and typescript-eslint's recommended presets carried over to oxlint, plus the bug-catching rules worth having, and the house formatting. Consumed as TypeScript source from the consumer's oxlint.config.ts and oxfmt.config.ts.
//peerDependencies: The tools are the consumer's: its scripts, hooks and editor run them. This package only imports their types.
